overall: Tomorrow (June 19) is expected to be a warm early-summer day in Atlanta, with a high likely in the upper 70s to low 80s°F based on the observation-informed ensemble, though pure forecast models suggest it could push into the mid-80s. The day's peak temperatures will represent a modest warming relative to today's observed high of 77°F. Overall confidence in the precise high is low, as the model distribution is very flat and diffuse.
